greeting: Your last hours on dry land in Dubrovnik, Dan — the Nautilus charter boards around five, so anything that needs the internet is best handled before you cast off. The girls are with Jen this stretch; it's you, Mike, and the boat from here.

needsAttention.title: Confirm boarding with the instructor
needsAttention.detail: You board the Nautilus charter around 5 today, and the task to confirm the meeting time, location, and the return airport transfer is still open. Nail it down before signal thins out.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Cavtat transfers
needsAttention.detail: Your Sept 19 Cavtat hotel is booked, but the Komolac-to-Cavtat transfer, the bag hold, and the early Sunday checkout all need arranging from dry land before you're underway (p1, overdue).

needsAttention.title: Pre-boarding shopping in Dubrovnik
needsAttention.detail: Cash, snacks, alcohol, and any gluten-free items are far easier now than aboard, and the window shuts at the 5 PM boarding. Studenac, Tommy, or Konzum are closest.

needsAttention.title: Reserve the Sept 20 to Oct 5 SUV
needsAttention.detail: The Tampa full-size SUV for your landing is no longer a hedge; book it while you have signal, since you arrive jet-lagged on a Sunday (p1, overdue).

needsAttention.title: Check the St Pete Airbnb converted
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 27 to Oct 5 St Pete booking was pending host acceptance; worth a glance that it confirmed rather than expired, and the Sept 20 to 22 landing gap still needs a bed (p1, overdue).

schedule.title: Board the sailing charter
schedule.detail: Nautilus course begins, marina in Dubrovnik (local time)

flagged.title: VP Government Affairs alert
flagged.detail: LinkedIn surfaced roles like VP, Government Affairs at The New York Times and Macy's.

flagged.title: Medical bill ready to pay
flagged.detail: A statement for an Aug 18 visit is now ready in your inbox.

inbox.noise: The rest is retail and newsletters, Tracksmith, Chairish, Foreign Affairs, NYT Cooking, and the daily language drills.
inbox.clear: Nothing is waiting on your reply.

resolved.title: Dubrovnik apartment leg closed out
resolved.detail: Your Old Port host left you a guest review; the apartment stay is done and behind you.

recipe.title: Duck breasts with apples & caraway
recipe.why: Autumn apples are at their crisp peak now, a natural foil for rich duck.

acts.line: A quiet last morning in Dubrovnik, the Old Port apartment and any final errands ashore.
The charter takes over: board the Nautilus boat around five and meet your instructor and crew.
First night aboard, and connectivity thins the moment you're underway, so square away anything online before then.
